title: चतुःसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 74 · The king and his priest

summary.en: Bhishma says that a king should have a learned priest, since kingship and the priestly order must stand together, and tells the story of Aila and Kashyapa. He says that the king who keeps the brahmins on his side prospers, and that the priest who does not teach dharma has no place.
summary.kn: ರಾಜನಿಗೆ ವಿದ್ವಾಂಸ ಪುರೋಹಿತ ಬೇಕು, ರಾಜತ್ವ ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣ ವರ್ಗ ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ನಿಲ್ಲಬೇಕೆಂದು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳಿ ಐಲ ಮತ್ತು ಕಶ್ಯಪನ ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣರನ್ನು ತನ್ನ ಪಕ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡ ರಾಜ ಏಳಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: भीष्म कहते हैं कि राजा का विद्वान पुरोहित हो क्योंकि राज्य और ब्राह्मण वर्ग को साथ चलना चाहिए, और ऐल तथा कश्यप की कथा सुनाते हैं। जो राजा ब्राह्मणों को अपने पक्ष में रखता है वह फलता-फूलता है।
summary.te: రాజుకు విద్వాంసుడైన పురోహితుడు ఉండాలని, రాజ్యం, బ్రాహ్మణ వర్గం కలిసి నిలవాలని భీష్ముడు చెప్పి ఐల, కశ్యపుల కథ చెబుతాడు. బ్రాహ్మణులను తన పక్షాన ఉంచుకున్న రాజు వర్ధిల్లుతాడంటాడు.
summary.ta: மன்னனுக்குக் கற்ற புரோகிதன் வேண்டும், அரசும் அந்தணர் குலமும் இணைந்து நிற்க வேண்டும் என்று பீஷ்மர் கூறி ஐலனும் காசியபரும் பற்றிய கதையைச் சொல்கிறார். அந்தணரைத் தன் பக்கம் வைத்த மன்னன் செழிக்கிறான் என்கிறார்.
summary.ml: രാജാവിന് ഒരു പണ്ഡിതനായ പുരോഹിതൻ വേണമെന്ന് ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു; രാജത്വവും പുരോഹിതവർഗ്ഗവും ഒന്നിച്ചു നിൽക്കണമെന്നും, ഐലന്റെയും കശ്യപന്റെയും കഥ അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു. ബ്രാഹ്മണരെ കൂടെ നിർത്തുന്ന രാജാവ് അഭിവൃദ്ധിപ്പെടുമെന്നും, ധർമ്മം പഠിപ്പിക്കാത്ത പുരോഹിതന് സ്ഥാനമില്ലെന്നും അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.74; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
राज्ञा पुरोहितः कार्यो भवेद्विद्वान्बहुश्रुतः ।
उभौ समीक्ष्य धर्मार्थावप्रमेयावनन्तरम् ॥

meaning.en: A king should appoint a learned household priest of wide scholarship, after weighing righteousness and wealth, both immeasurable and ever following one another.

verses.text:
धर्मात्मा धर्मविद्येषां राज्ञां राजन्पुरोहितः ।
राजा चैवंगुणो येषां कुशलं तेषु सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: King, among those kings whose priest is righteous and knows righteousness, and whose king has such qualities too, all is well in every way.

verses.text:
उभौ प्रजा वर्धयतो देवान्पूर्वान्परान्पितॄन् ।
यौ समेयास्थितौ धर्मे श्रद्धेयौ सुतपस्विनौ ॥

meaning.en: The two together make the people prosper, and the gods, the ancient ancestors and the later ones; when they unite and stand in righteousness, they are to be trusted and are great ascetics.

verses.text:
परस्परस्य सुहृदौ संमतौ समचेतसौ ।
ब्रह्मक्षत्रस्य संमानात्प्रजाः सुखमवाप्नुयुः ॥

meaning.en: They are friends to one another, agreed and of one mind; when Brahmana and Kshatriya are honoured, the people gain happiness.

verses.text:
विमाननात्तयोरेव प्रजा नश्येयुरेव ह ।
ब्रह्मक्षत्रं हि सर्वेषां धर्माणां मूलमुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: If these two are slighted, the people surely perish, for the priestly and the warrior power are called the root of all duties.

verses.text:
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ।
ऐलकश्यपसंवादं तं निबोध युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: On this they cite an ancient tale, the conversation of Aila and Kashyapa; hear it, Yudhishthira.

verses.text: ऐल उवाच

meaning.en: Aila said:

verses.text:
यदा हि ब्रह्म प्रजहाति क्षत्रं
क्षत्रं यदा वा प्रजहाति ब्रह्म ।
अन्वग्बलं कतमेऽस्मिन्भजन्ते
तथाबल्यं कतमेऽस्मिन्वियन्ति ॥

meaning.en: When the priestly power abandons the warrior power, or the warrior power abandons the priestly, which of the two do the strong follow in that case, and which do the weak leave?

verses.text: कश्यप उवाच

meaning.en: Kashyapa said:

verses.text:
व्यृद्धं राष्ट्रं भवति क्षत्रियस्य
ब्रह्म क्षत्रं यत्र विरुध्यते ह ।
अन्वग्बलं दस्यवस्तद्भजन्ते-
ऽबल्यं तथा तत्र वियन्ति सन्तः ॥

meaning.en: The Kshatriya's kingdom is ruined where the priestly and warrior powers are at odds. Robbers then follow the stronger side, and the good depart from the weak.

verses.text:
नैषामुक्षा वर्धते नोत उस्रा
न गर्गरो मथ्यते नो यजन्ते ।
नैषां पुत्रा वेदमधीयते च
यदा ब्रह्म क्षत्रियाः संत्यजन्ति ॥

meaning.en: Their bull does not thrive, nor does the calf; the churning pot is not worked and no sacrifices are made; their sons do not study the Veda, when the Kshatriyas abandon the priests.

verses.text:
नैषामुक्षा वर्धते जातु गेहे
नाधीयते सप्रजा नो यजन्ते ।
अपध्वस्ता दस्युभूता भवन्ति
ये ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रियान्संत्यजन्ति ॥

meaning.en: Their bull never thrives in the house, they do not study, and with their offspring they do not sacrifice; those Brahmanas who abandon Kshatriyas become ruined and turn into robbers.

verses.text:
एतौ हि नित्यसंयुक्तावितरेतरधारणे ।
क्षत्रं हि ब्रह्मणो योनिर्योनिः क्षत्रस्य च द्विजाः ॥

meaning.en: These two are always bound together, each supporting the other; the Kshatriya is the womb of the Brahmana and the twice-born are the womb of the Kshatriya.

verses.text:
उभावेतौ नित्यमभिप्रपन्नौ
संप्रापतुर्महतीं श्रीप्रतिष्ठाम् ।
तयोः संधिर्भिद्यते चेत्पुराण-
स्ततः सर्वं भवति हि संप्रमूढम् ॥

meaning.en: Always resorting to one another, these two have gained great glory and standing. If their ancient bond is broken, everything becomes confused.

verses.text:
नात्र प्लवं लभते पारगामी
महागाधे नौरिव संप्रणुन्ना ।
चातुर्वर्ण्यं भवति च संप्रमूढं
ततः प्रजाः क्षयसंस्था भवन्ति ॥

meaning.en: The traveller finds no raft there, like a boat tossed on a vast deep; the four classes become confused, and then the people fall into ruin.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मवृक्षो रक्ष्यमाणो मधु हेम च वर्षति ।
अरक्ष्यमाणः सततमश्रु पापं च वर्षति ॥

meaning.en: The tree of the priestly power, if protected, rains honey and gold; if left unprotected, it rains tears and sin all the time.

verses.text:
अब्रह्मचारी चरणादपेतो
यदा ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मणि त्राणमिच्छेत् ।
आश्चर्यशो वर्षति तत्र देव-
स्तत्राभीक्ष्णं दुःसहाश्चाविशन्ति ॥

meaning.en: When one who is not a celibate student and has fallen from his conduct seeks protection in Brahmanahood, the god rains in wonder there, and unbearable ills keep entering.

verses.text:
स्त्रियं हत्वा ब्राह्मणं वापि पापः
सभायां यत्र लभतेऽनुवादम् ।
राज्ञः सकाशे न बिभेति चापि
ततो भयं जायते क्षत्रियस्य ॥

meaning.en: Where a sinner who has killed a woman or a Brahmana gets praise in the assembly and does not fear the king's presence, from that fear arises for the Kshatriya.

verses.text:
पापैः पापे क्रियमाणेऽतिवेलं
ततो रुद्रो जायते देव एषः ।
पापैः पापाः संजनयन्ति रुद्रं
ततः सर्वान्साध्वसाधून्हिनस्ति ॥

meaning.en: When sinners commit sin beyond measure, then this god Rudra is born; sinners beget Rudra by their sins, and he then destroys the good and the bad alike.

verses.text: ऐल उवाच

meaning.en: Aila said:

verses.text:
कुतो रुद्रः कीदृशो वापि रुद्रः
सत्त्वैः सत्त्वं दृश्यते वध्यमानम् ।
एतद्विद्वन्कश्यप मे प्रचक्ष्व
यतो रुद्रो जायते देव एषः ॥

meaning.en: Whence is Rudra, and what is he like? One creature is seen killed by other creatures. Wise Kashyapa, tell me this: from where is this god Rudra born?

verses.text: कश्यप उवाच

meaning.en: Kashyapa said:

verses.text:
आत्मा रुद्रो हृदये मानवानां
स्वं स्वं देहं परदेहं च हन्ति ।
वातोत्पातैः सदृशं रुद्रमाहु-
र्दावैर्जीमूतैः सदृशं रूपमस्य ॥

meaning.en: Rudra is the self in the hearts of men, who kills his own body and the bodies of others. They say Rudra is like storms of wind, and his form is like forest fires and clouds.

verses.text: ऐल उवाच

meaning.en: Aila said:

verses.text:
न वै वातं परिवृनोति कश्चि-
न्न जीमूतो वर्षति नैव दावः ।
तथायुक्तो दृश्यते मानवेषु
कामद्वेषाद्बध्यते मुच्यते च ॥

meaning.en: No one holds back the wind; the cloud does not rain, nor does the forest fire burn, in such a way among men. Men are bound or freed by desire and hatred.

verses.text: कश्यप उवाच

meaning.en: Kashyapa said:

verses.text:
यथैकगेहे जातवेदाः प्रदीप्तः
कृत्स्नं ग्रामं प्रदहेत्स त्वरावान् ।
विमोहनं कुरुते देव एष
ततः सर्वं स्पृश्यते पुण्यपापैः ॥

meaning.en: As fire blazing in one house quickly burns the whole village, so this god causes confusion, and then everything is touched by merit and sin alike.

verses.text: ऐल उवाच

meaning.en: Aila said:

verses.text:
यदि दण्डः स्पृशते पुण्यभाजं
पापैः पापे क्रियमाणेऽविशेषात् ।
कस्य हेतोः सुकृतं नाम कुर्या-
द्दुष्कृतं वा कस्य हेतोर्न कुर्यात् ॥

meaning.en: If punishment touches the man of merit just the same when sin is committed by sinners, then why should one do good, and why should one not do evil?

verses.text: कश्यप उवाच

meaning.en: Kashyapa said:

verses.text:
असंत्यागात्पापकृतामपापां-
स्तुल्यो दण्डः स्पृशते मिश्रभावात् ।
शुष्केणार्द्रं दह्यते मिश्रभावा-
न्न मिश्रः स्यात्पापकृद्भिः कथंचित् ॥

meaning.en: Because they do not separate from sinners, the blameless are touched by equal punishment through mixing; the wet burns with the dry through mixing. So one should never mix with those who do wrong.

verses.text: ऐल उवाच

meaning.en: Aila said:

verses.text:
साध्वसाधून्धारयतीह भूमिः
साध्वसाधूंस्तापयतीह सूर्यः ।
साध्वसाधून्वातयतीह वायु-
रापस्तथा साध्वसाधून्वहन्ति ॥

meaning.en: The earth here bears the good and the bad; the sun here warms the good and the bad; the wind blows on the good and the bad; and the waters carry the good and the bad.

verses.text: कश्यप उवाच

meaning.en: Kashyapa said:

verses.text:
एवमस्मिन्वर्तते लोक एव
नामुत्रैवं वर्तते राजपुत्र ।
प्रेत्यैतयोरन्तरवान्विशेषो
यो वै पुण्यं चरते यश्च पापम् ॥

meaning.en: So it goes in this world, prince, but not so in the next. After death there is a great difference between the one who does good and the one who does evil.

verses.text:
पुण्यस्य लोको मधुमान्घृतार्चि-
र्हिरण्यज्योतिरमृतस्य नाभिः ।
तत्र प्रेत्य मोदते ब्रह्मचारी
न तत्र मृत्युर्न जरा नोत दुःखम् ॥

meaning.en: The world of the righteous is full of honey, with flames of ghee, golden light, and is the navel of immortality. There the celibate rejoices after death; there is no death, no old age, and no sorrow.

verses.text:
पापस्य लोको निरयोऽप्रकाशो
नित्यं दुःखः शोकभूयिष्ठ एव ।
तत्रात्मानं शोचते पापकर्मा
बह्वीः समाः प्रपतन्नप्रतिष्ठः ॥

meaning.en: The world of sinners is hell, without light, always painful and full of grief. There the evildoer mourns for himself, falling for many years with no foothold.

verses.text:
मिथो भेदाद्ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियाणां
प्रजा दुःखं दुःसहं चाविशन्ति ।
एवं ज्ञात्वा कार्य एवेह विद्वा-
न्पुरोहितो नैकविद्यो नृपेण ॥

meaning.en: Through discord between Brahmanas and Kshatriyas, the people fall into unbearable suffering. Knowing this, a king should appoint a learned household priest, not one skilled in only one branch.

verses.text:
तं चैवान्वभिषिच्येत तथा धर्मो विधीयते ।
अग्र्यो हि ब्राह्मणः प्रोक्तः सर्वस्यैवेह धर्मतः ॥

meaning.en: Him he should also consecrate, for so the law is ordained; the Brahmana is called the foremost of all in matters of righteousness.

verses.text:
पूर्वं हि ब्राह्मणाः सृष्टा इति धर्मविदो विदुः ।
ज्येष्ठेनाभिजनेनास्य प्राप्तं सर्वं यदुत्तरम् ॥

meaning.en: Those who know righteousness say Brahmanas were created first; by being eldest and by birth, all that is higher comes to him.

verses.text:
तस्मान्मान्यश्च पूज्यश्च ब्राह्मणः प्रसृताग्रभुक् ।
सर्वं श्रेष्ठं वरिष्ठं च निवेद्यं तस्य धर्मतः ॥

meaning.en: Therefore the Brahmana is to be honoured and respected, taking the first portion with outstretched hand; the best and choicest of everything should rightly be offered to him.

verses.text:
अवश्यमेतत्कर्तव्यं राज्ञा बलवतापि हि ।
ब्रह्म वर्धयति क्षत्रं क्षत्रतो ब्रह्म वर्धते ॥

meaning.en: A king must do this, even if powerful; the priestly power makes the warrior power grow, and from the warrior power the priestly power grows.
